acceptanceCriteria: Root build applies Kover to component/root without editing their module build files and directly aggregates all six production logic projects.
Coverage filters include domain, data, component, root, platform and monetization; only generated/resource/preview classes are excluded.
The default application line threshold is at least 60 percent and any override is validated in 1..100; a package-grouped rule prevents an entirely uncovered included package.
Root check runs all six host suites before report/verify without an override. CI is not changed because its existing ordering already does this.
No module build file, production/test source, workflow, dependency catalog, ledger or unrelated root configuration is changed; specialist does not run Gradle.
goal: Make QG-001 coverage meaningful from the root build only: apply Kover to the uninstrumented component/root projects, aggregate domain/data/component/root/platform/monetization, measure all six package roots, and enforce a nonzero defensible line threshold plus per-package coverage presence.
